assertions.claim: Order: press the wound hard by hand/cloth → limb bleeding not controllable → tourniquet → call 120 → don't loosen the tourniquet.
assertions.cn_span: 四肢压不住就上止血带

assertions.claim: Field data: tourniquet before shock → 90% survived; after shock → 10%; all 5 who needed one and didn't get it died (Baghdad field hospital, 232 casualties).
assertions.cn_span: 休克出现前上止血带的活了 90%，休克之后才上只剩 10%，该上没上的 5 个人全死了

assertions.claim: Place above the wound, twist until bleeding stops, record the time.
assertions.cn_span: 扎在伤口上方、拧到血停、记下时间

assertions.claim: Neck and torso can only be pressed, not bandaged with a tourniquet; don't substitute shoelaces/rope.
assertions.cn_span: 脖子和躯干只能压不能扎

assertions.claim: Texas 6 years, 11 level-I trauma centers, 1026 limb vascular injuries; crude mortality 3.9% with tourniquet vs 5.2% without; adjusted OR 5.86 (1.41–24.47).
assertions.cn_span: 多因素校正后止血带与存活独立相关（校正 OR 5.86，95% CI 1.41 到 24.47）

assertions.claim: In the Kragh data the tourniquet itself never caused an amputation; 4 cases of transient nerve palsy; don't periodically loosen it to 'let blood out'.
assertions.cn_span: Kragh 数据里止血带本身没有导致截肢，短暂神经麻痹 4 例
